risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in an environment where competition ranges from moderate to intense. Several competitors have greater financial resources. The potential entry of new competitors into the static measurement market could affect market share.

risks.title: Supplier dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on sole-source suppliers for certain components, which could result in operational disruptions if these suppliers are lost.

risks.title: Raw material risks
risks.score_rationale: The prices and availability of raw materials used in the company's product manufacturing are influenced by economic and industrial factors that are difficult to predict.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in government laws and regulations could affect the company's operations and results, particularly those related to products and safety standards.

risks.title: Economic risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's ability to generate revenue and improve profitability depends on general conditions in the U.S. and foreign economies, including the availability of public funding for utilities.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risks due to sales to foreign customers and purchases of materials from foreign suppliers.

risks.title: Litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risks due to its participation in ordinary business activities and its reliance on suppliers and customers.

ai_positioning.summary: BMI does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K filing. The focus remains on water management solutions and measurement technologies.
